Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) is a new credit loss accounting standard (model) that was issued by the
Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) on June 16, 2016. CECL replaces the current Allowance for Loan
and Lease Losses (ALLL) accounting standard. The CECL standard focuses on estimation of expected losses over
the life of the loans, while the current standard relies on incurred losses.
